milestones.label: Application deadline for the 2027-28 call (set by each country's Fulbright Commission or U.S. Embassy; already passed)
milestones.time_text: Varies by country; July to August 2026 (India: 9 July 2026)
milestones.source_text: USIEF, the Fulbright commission in India (official partner), lists 9 July 2026 as its closing date for the 2027-28 Humphrey call. A funding-news aggregator reports other countries' deadlines between mid-July and end of August 2026. The Humphrey programme office itself defers to local commissions and embassies for dates. The 2028-29 call has not been announced.

milestones.label: Finalists told of selection (2027-28 call)
milestones.source_text: USIEF India says it expects the selection notice from Washington in April 2027 and will then tell finalists; the fellowship starts in August or September 2027. This is the Indian commission's timeline; other countries may differ.
